topic: The Hidden Cost of Delaying Your SIP
caption:
5 saal ki deri aur ₹32 Lakhs ka nuksan? 😱
Hum hamesha sochte hain ki investing baad mein karenge, abhi salary kam hai.
Par compounding timing se chalti hai, salary ke size se nahi.
Aaj hi ₹500 se bhi SIP shuru kar sakte ho!
Kya aapne apni pehli SIP shuru kar di hai ya abhi bhi wait kar rahe ho? Comment mein batao!
